mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a significant decrease in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5pp in 1 month does not lead to a significant decrease in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months does not lead to a significant decrease in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM does not lead to a significant increase in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 1 month does not lead to a significant increase in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM does not lead to a significant increase in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If a decrease in FEDFUNDS does not lead to a significant increase in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease does not lead to a significant increase in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
